notes: Golden set for agent/classifier.py. Labels are what a reader of the message would expect, not a transcript of what the model currently answers - a case the model fails is a finding, not a broken test. Every case runs with timezone Europe/Madrid, so 'today' and 'tomorrow' are that clock's. Values: a string asserts equality (case-insensitive), null asserts the field is empty, 'any' asserts it is filled, 'today'/'tomorrow' assert that date.

test_cases.message: what's on tonight in Madrid?
any jazz in Barcelona tomorrow?
when does Vetusta Morla play next?
gigs near me this week
test_cases.known_gap: returns query_type event_search with near_me true. Nothing defines when "nearby" is the type and route() keys off near_me alone, so the value is unreachable vocabulary - either the prompt names it or the Literal loses it.

test_cases.known_gap: returns first_query with near_me true and no clarification. route() then drops the only plan, so the turn answers "nothing found" instead of asking where the user is - and router.py's own comment claims the classifier marks these ambiguous.
